method: Read all324 permanent failure, native-contract and negative acceptance source-duty propositions, all8 full context profiles and6 caption occurrence sets. Every full payload is compared with immutable predecessor evidence; all1917 old occurrence bindings are transported exactly. Individual invariant/forbidden-failure predicates are distinguished from current typed-domain, complete evidence and readiness duties. The referenced test implementations and proof results are not opened.

decisions.EXACT_SOURCE_SUITE_CONTEXT: The exact heading, mandatory source-suite owner and child occurrence set remain. Each child is separately reconciled; preserving the caption neither retains changed child semantics nor adds inserted clauses to old occurrence ranges.
decisions.PRESERVED_PERMANENT: The individual forbidden failure remains forbidden: invented semantic inspection, reduced extraction, machine-schema replacement of human conversation, redundant resupply, unauthorized prompt/actor authority, visual regression, hidden lineage, fabricated independence, prose or hashes substituted for observed meaning, swallowed contradiction, described but unexecuted regression, native impersonation or partial canonical mutation. A preserves conversational ownership; C separates accounting from semantic reading; D preserves isolation and limits; F1/F2 preserve actual observations and stronger proof. Exact current-domain exceptions are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_NATIVE: The examined individual primitive name, named-port/DAG structure, explicit one/multiple immutable artifact binding, exact byte/SHA relation, no implicit floating equality, centralized limit, prohibited execution, atomic application authority, exact runtime/input identity, semantic-change invalidation or compatibility-only migration invariant is unchanged. D changes allowed types/outcomes inside these boundaries. Retention asserts no old digest, XML interpretation, implementation or proof.
decisions.PRESERVED_NEGATIVE: The individual malformed transport, wrong revision/stage/identity, ownership, nonfinite JSON, cross-project reference, mismatched bytes, stale/duplicate proposal, absent actual observation/RCA/version/lineage, fabricated independence, omitted or non-ten run, non-atomic requirement, order-dependent logical identity, rewritten history, forbidden execution, missing retrieval/resupply, unsafe rendering, unauthorized external action, wrong origin, fabricated delivery/backup, stale/unpinned proof, absent checkpoint, runtime-governance leakage, invalid machine time or precedence failure remains invalid. A human DATE does not change machine RFC3339; C1 leaves response transport separate; F2 echoes supply no execution/meaning/independence proof.
decisions.PRESERVED_ATOMIC_STORAGE: For injected storage failure the exact allowed outcome remains a complete canonical commit or no canonical state change. C1 reservation accounting cannot permit partial canonical mutation. Complete coverage of newly admitted object domains changes separately.
decisions.PRESERVED_SOURCE_SEARCH: The source universe still derives from the objective, supplied references and generic source-class checklist. Narrowing still requires explicit justification and independent adequacy review, with search criteria and dispositions. Intake unitization or input echoes cannot narrow the research universe or establish search adequacy.
decisions.EXACT_RAW_INSPECTION_AND_HANDOFF: The actual counted/inspected/handed-off source population now uses C/C1 exact physical, structural and text-span occurrences, additive authorized archive units and typed resource blockers. The existing challenge threshold is retained but its counted universe changes. F2 input support is additional, never semantic inspection. Decoder reference limits remain conditional.
decisions.CLOSED_HUMAN_REQUEST_CASES: The actual closed fallback item keys, answer types and optional/blocking predicate now follow A, so undeclared keys and over-blocking require current cases. The unchanged conversational ask-or-explicit-defer failure is separately corrected. Optional unanswered information waives no other requirement and supplies no factual assertion.
decisions.COMPLETE_INTAKE_AND_RESEARCH: Complete current intake/research persistence and downstream consumption include A-valid fallback context, C/C1 exact accounting and source lineage and F2 admitted current input. Existing exhaustive semantic passes and no repeated resupply remain. Decoder-dependent completeness retains its explicit qualifier.
decisions.COMPLETE_RESEARCH_AND_OBLIGATIONS: Complete research/source/obligation coverage now consumes A-valid and F2-supported current external responses with the original review and coverage duties. Missing or rejected evidence cannot shrink the required population or establish acceptance.
decisions.SUPPORTED_NATIVE_AND_CURRENT_READY: Actual required artifacts and supported/ready native cases now use B current reviewed availability, D exact typed support, E current test context and applicable F1/F2 execution/input prerequisites. UNKNOWN and unresolved XML/binding semantics cannot be favorable readiness. Original executor selection and authorized external fallback boundaries remain.

E permitted nonoperative context is bounded, not an arbitrary extension exemption.

The rejection predicate must use that changed domain while specialized inherited details remain conditional.

Initial proof authoring is not accepted independent proof. Future-visible duties remain, UNKNOWN is not FALSE, and missing proof cannot erase applicability.
decisions.MIGRATION_AND_TYPED_NATIVE_ARGUMENTS: Complete current native migration/argument/property/binding cases now use D exact required and optional types/forms and B/E proof/test relationships. No coercion, implicit operand selection or historical schema name supplies conformance. Execution failure or unknown input is not refutation or compliance. Applicable XML limits remain explicit.

Wrong/extra/missing ports reject definitions; error/partial predecessors cannot feed dependent execution. Applicable XML-node interpretation stays qualified.
decisions.CLOSED_TYPE_NULL_EMPTY_RELATIONSHIP_DOMA: A/B/D/E/F1 close current typed values, null/empty allowances, proof/test relationships, variance cardinality/equality and conditional binding dimensions. Invalid cases must reflect this precise domain. Empty request/allowed affected arrays and equal direct/embedded variance cannot be rejected indiscriminately; conditional binding details are not invented.
decisions.PROVENANCE_INPUT_EVIDENCE_DOMAIN: Current required provenance/evidence/byte cases include C/C1 exact occurrences, B reviewed availability, F1 distinct actual input/execution identities and F2 route-specific support. An attributable echo does not establish external observed custody or execution. Missing decoder/binding dependencies remain qualified.
decisions.CURRENT_COMPLETE_TRANSACTION_AND_IMPORT: The complete current durable transaction/import domain includes amended requests, source provenance, tests, variance and conditional execution records. Exact original/extension/history custody, migration quarantine and no partial canonical mutation remain. Parseability of old objects does not establish full current admission.
decisions.CURRENT_TEST_AND_VERIFICATION_COVERAGE: Complete current Stage06/verification matrices include B availability, D typed definitions/results, E variance identities and F1 due conditional executions plus A/F2 admitted external evidence. Every mandatory cell and future-visible relation remains. Unknown prerequisites cannot reduce this population.
decisions.CURRENT_ITERATION_AUDIT_RELEASE_CHAIN: Complete current iteration, convergence/release and process/product audit chain predicates consume every applicable amended upstream intake/review/test/variance/execution/input prerequisite. Fixed order, ten-run arithmetic, exact lineage and release precedence remain. Structure alone cannot establish semantics or inherit old proof.
decisions.CURRENT_MEANING_AND_REPRESENTATION_REVIE: Complete accepted external meaning/representation review now includes A response validation and F2 exact input basis in addition to unchanged observed meaning, artifact-set, evidence and independence duties. Input support is not sufficient semantic inspection or hidden independence proof.
decisions.CURRENT_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: The complete current adversarial review must address A/B/D/E/F1/F2 current predicates and input basis while preserving its original independent challenge/evidence standard. This is the source duty for review cases, not proof that any review ran.

Base315–317 identifies every such issue, base408 requires asking or explicit deferral, and base561 preserves that exact lifecycle. Base1533 expressly distinguishes final humanInputRequests fallback from normal conversation. A closes the fallback item/answer format and says an optional unanswered item waives no other requirement; it does not alter the duty to ask or explicitly defer. Retain this exact failure predicate. Current typed-answer, blocking and complete intake acceptance cases remain separately changed.
